annotations.text:
Everything here is clickable.

- The D-pad's left/right arms drive the carousel (dots below work too)
- VINTAGE / MODERN in the header swaps the whole theme live
- Search and the category chips filter the grid for real

2048 is the only real entry — title and tagline come from catalog.json. The other nine games, all scores, player handles and play counts are invented to make the layout look true to life.

Heads up: leaderboards and a second game are v0 out-of-scope in CLAUDE.md. This designs where the hub is going, not what ships next.
